module: FastIron ICX™ 7750, ICX™ 7250 and ICX™ 7150 Series Switch/Router
description: The Ruckus ICX 7750 delivers chassis performance in the network’s aggregation and core switching operations. The Ruckus ICX 7250 delivers stand-out performance and flexibility, and SDN readiness that cost-effectively scales as demands grow and new technologies emerge. The Ruckus ICX 7150 combines enterprise-class switching features with high performance at entry-level price.The ICX 7150 family of switches are in available in three formats: standard, Z-Series with Multigigabit support, and compact.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); MD5; NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
